title: Merchant names that drift between statements
when: The same merchant appears under several descriptors, so a recurring charge looks like a new one or a price change is missed.

strategies.summary: Deterministic cleanup: strip payment-processor prefixes (e.g. 'TBX*', 'SQ *'), phone numbers, store and reference numbers; collapse whitespace; compare the remaining brand token.
Token similarity plus charge history: treat two descriptors as one merchant when they share a distinctive token and charge within three days of the same day of month for a similar amount.
strategies.risk: Could merge two unrelated merchants with similar names and amounts.

strategies.summary: Look each raw descriptor up in an external merchant-information service and use the canonical name it returns.
strategies.risk: Sends merchant descriptors, and with them spending patterns, to a third party.
